data, not by computing faster.

div.font:
The fusions are computationally exact and not approximations -- F{w.s}, a pointwise scale commutes with the read;
azimuth gather -- the feeder already chooses which sample to present; detect -- |z| is pointwise on the FFT output;

div.style: text-align: left;

span.font: corner-turn #2 -- strip-pipelined against FFT-2, legal because the 1-D transforms of distinct rows are independent.
